entries.title: Galatians 1:1
segments: ¶Paul, an apostle (not from men nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised Him from the dead),

entries.title: Galatians 1:2
segments: and all the brethren who are with me, To the churches of Galatia:

entries.title: Galatians 1:3
segments: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Galatians 1:4
segments: who gave Himself for our sins, that He might deliver us from this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,

entries.title: Galatians 1:5
segments: to whom [be] glory forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: Galatians 1:6
segments: ¶I marvel that you are turning away so soon from Him who called you in the grace of Christ, to a different gospel,

entries.title: Galatians 1:7
segments: which is not another; but there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the gospel of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:8
segments: But even if we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel to you than what we have preached to you, let him be accursed.

entries.title: Galatians 1:9
segments: As we have said before, so now I say again, if anyone preaches any other gospel to you than what you have received, let him be accursed.

entries.title: Galatians 1:10
segments: ¶For do I now persuade men, or God? Or do I seek to please men? For if I still pleased men, I would not be a bondservant of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:11
segments: But I make known to you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached by me is not according to man.

entries.title: Galatians 1:12
segments: For I neither received it from man, nor was I taught [it], but [it came] through the revelation of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:13
segments: For you have heard of my former conduct in Judaism, how I persecuted the church of God beyond measure and [tried to] destroy it.

entries.title: Galatians 1:14
segments: And I advanced in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries in my own nation, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

entries.title: Galatians 1:15
segments: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb and called [me] through His grace,

entries.title: Galatians 1:16
segments: to reveal His Son in me, that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately confer with flesh and blood,

entries.title: Galatians 1:17
segments: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those [who were] apostles before me; but I went to Arabia, and returned again to Damascus.

entries.title: Galatians 1:18
segments: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and remained with him fifteen days.

entries.title: Galatians 1:19
segments: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord's brother.

entries.title: Galatians 1:20
segments: (Now [concerning] the things which I write to you, indeed, before God, I do not lie.)

entries.title: Galatians 1:21
segments: Afterward I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

entries.title: Galatians 1:22
segments: And I was unknown by face to the churches of Judea which [were] in Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:23
segments: But they were hearing only, "He who formerly persecuted us now preaches the faith which he once [tried to] destroy."

entries.title: Galatians 1:24
segments: And they glorified God in me.
